page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfc5.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 6149 processor running at 3.1 GHz. It features 8 dedicated physical cores with 8 vCPUs, utilizing a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio. The memory configuration consists of 16.0 GB of RAM, providing 2.0 GB per core. This instance does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and it operates on a KVM hypervisor with a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates average multi-core CPU performance, with a stress-ng multi-core score of 7203.49 and a Passmark CPU score of 8280.79. However, single-core performance is weak, as shown by a Geekbench single-core score of 1091.0 and a stress-ng single-core score of 1355.68. Memory performance is mixed; cached small-block read bandwidth is average at 402.4 GB/sec, whereas uncached large-block read bandwidth falls into the weak category at 38.98 GB/sec. The instance demonstrates average capabilities in software compilation, ray tracing, and Redis SET operations, but scores poorly in database operations and static web serving.

From a resource density perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and 1:2 memory-to-vCPU ratio make this instance a cost-efficient option for compute-bound tasks that do not require high memory density or local storage. However, the weak single-core performance represents a tradeoff for single-threaded applications. This server is best suited for compute-focused workloads with modest memory footprints, such as software compilation, basic web serving, and lightweight parallel processing tasks.
